title: Time capability issuance can be bypassed through callable _issue and post-issue mutation
description: Security review: _SampleAuthority._issue is callable on every bound TimeProvider/DioTimeVerifier and bypasses all provider/verifier validation. TimeSample and ProvisionEpochMetadata are accepted by exact object identity only, but object.__setattr__ can mutate frozen dataclass fields after issuance while the issuer still accepts the object. Remove callable underscored issuance surfaces from capability instances and bind acceptance to an immutable issuer-held snapshot/authenticator of all security-relevant fields; add forged _issue and post-issuance mutation tests.
notes: Also reject authority subclasses/overridden accepts methods at tracker binding (use exact sealed authority types or a non-overridable capability record); isinstance currently admits a subclass that can return true for forged samples.
